# Rule reference

<!-- Generated by tools/L3Lint.DocsGen from the shipped rule packs. Do not edit by hand. -->

l3lint ships 78 rules in 5 rule packs. Each rule has its own page with the requirement, the reason, the check, the fix, its public sources and a passing and a failing example. `l3lint explain <ruleId>` prints the same page in a terminal.

Findings are advisory. A finding says a payload is likely to downgrade or misses a documented requirement; a clean result says the payload meets the documented requirements l3lint checks. Card networks and issuers decide the rate. See [Rules, severity and confidence](../articles/rules.md) for how to read the columns below.
